Method of Attack: DLL hijacking via Windows 7 Calculator app by placing malicious WindowsCodecs.dll in the same folder as calc.exe to load malware
Using password-protected ZIP archives with ISO files containing malicious .LNK shortcuts and DLLs to evade antivirus detection
Impacted Systems: Windows systems vulnerable to DLL hijacking with Windows 7 calc.exe
Attack Vector: Malspam emails with HTML attachments that download password-protected ZIP archives containing ISO files
User mounts ISO and clicks .LNK shortcut masquerading as PDF, triggering calc.exe execution and DLL hijacking
Indicators of Compromise: Password-protected ZIP archive with ISO file containing .LNK file, calc.exe (Windows 7 Calculator), WindowsCodecs.dll, and 7533.dll
Use of Windows 7 calc.exe executable instead of Windows 10+ versions
